B.4.b.

re Karl OTTEN group:

On 5.8.38 M/S had an interesting talk with WOLFFSOHN. The following points of interest were obtained:

The group which meets at 19 Oppidans Road has been christened by its various intimates as the "Primrose League" on account of its proximity to Primrose Hill. This nickname also serves as a cover when conversation is taking place outside the premises. Incidentally the name is regarded as a huge joke. According to WOLFFSOHN, he and Dr. REICHENBACH are two unwilling members of this group. WOLFFSOHN is necessary to them on account of his knowledge of German and other military aircraft, while REICHENBACH is considered to be an economic expert. Both REICHENNACH and WOLFFSOHN dislike the work of this group as they are terrified that the British authorities may get wind of the business and turn them out of the country for having indulged in political activity. WOLFFSOHN is particularly anxious to avoid trouble as he is putting up for naturalisation in October 1938. On the other hand both these two men realise that there is money to be made out of the work of the group and they are not in a position to sacrifice this. For instance, LEHMANN RUSSBUELDT has now agreed to pay WOLFFSOHN £30 to write the historical chapters of the book on Germany's air force which was mentioned in previous reports. Incidentally, WOLFFSOHN says that when RUSSBUELDT wants anything he always has plenty of money to pay for it, but WOLFFSOHN cannot think where he gets his money from. In addition to the Intelligence work which is being done by the group, all sorts of ambitious projects are discussed by the members - "How to undermine Hitler's power in Germany", "How to preserve Czecho-Slovakia's independence",
